note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2). Bottle-alcove close-up: all eight words are masculine and sit right of the divider; sign, bench and rope are setting on the left. One box per item; zoom_back bottom-left.

items.label: le whisky
items.scene: Same as English 'whisky' (said wees-KEE): an amber WHISKY bottle with a tartan ribbon.

items.label: le cigare
items.scene: Same as English 'cigar' (said see-GAHR): a fat CIGAR lies in an open cedar box, unlit.

items.label: le rhum
items.scene: Like English 'rum' but said ROM: a pirate parrot guards a small barrel of RUM.

items.label: le cognac
items.scene: Same as English 'cognac' (said koh-NYAHK): a round balloon glass of amber COGNAC by a candle.

items.label: le cidre
items.scene: Like English 'cider' but said SEEDR: red apples tumble from a basket beside a fizzy bottle of CIDER.

items.label: le vignoble
items.scene: A NOBLE little knight with a big V on his shield (vee-NYOBL) stands guard beside a painting of his hillside VINEYARD.

items.label: le tire-bouchon
items.scene: Literally 'pull-cork' (teer-boo-SHOHN): a little mouse leans back and TUGS a CORKSCREW until the cork pops free.

items.label: le gourmet
items.scene: Same as English 'gourmet' (said goor-MEH): a plump GOURMET, napkin tucked in, sniffs a wedge of blue cheese with closed eyes.
